name: 女か虎か(The Lady, or the Tiger?)

p_114901908a.sentence: Now, this king had a daughter as passionate as himself, and just as used to having her way.
p_114901908a.prev: You can imagine how closely the crowd watched.
p_114901908a.next: She loved a handsome, brave young courtier of low rank.

p_fcdff5b13d.sentence: Before you answer, consider the heart of that hot-blooded princess, caught between despair and jealousy.
p_fcdff5b13d.prev: What came out—the tiger or the lady?
p_fcdff5b13d.next: On that heart, the answer depends.

p_d199d13f46.sentence: Could she bear to lose him to the tiger?
p_d199d13f46.prev: Yet how often had she pictured him beside the woman she hated, smiling while wedding bells rang and flowers fell?
p_d199d13f46.next: Could she bear to see him become that lady’s husband?

p_826d93ca76.sentence: On the appointed day, the arena was crowded.
p_826d93ca76.prev: He sent the young man to prison and ordered him to face the doors.
p_826d93ca76.next: The young man stepped onto the sand.

p_f7f32b0da6.sentence: She also knew who waited behind one of them: one of the fairest young women at court.
p_f7f32b0da6.prev: With gold and determination, she had discovered the secret of the doors.

p_2d1dcf8a0e.sentence: He looks up, searching the princess’s face.
p_2d1dcf8a0e.prev: Now watch the young man with me.
p_2d1dcf8a0e.next: He has trusted her to learn the secret, and he sees that she has succeeded.

p_aec0b5ad2d.sentence: Her right hand rested on the cushioned wall before her.
p_aec0b5ad2d.next: She moved it slightly toward the right.

p_f332b8d699.sentence: I leave the question to you, and to all of us.
p_f332b8d699.prev: I will not answer for her.
p_f332b8d699.next: Which came out of the opened door—the lady, or the tiger?

p_171fce9a97.sentence: No one but her lover noticed.
p_171fce9a97.prev: She moved it slightly toward the right.
p_171fce9a97.next: He crossed the sand with firm, quick steps.

p_1615a75def.sentence: She loved a handsome, brave young courtier of low rank.
p_1615a75def.prev: Now, this king had a daughter as passionate as himself, and just as used to having her way.

p_8b86dd0df0.sentence: Her decision had cost her anguish.
p_8b86dd0df0.prev: For days and nights, she had struggled with those thoughts.
p_8b86dd0df0.next: Yet when the moment came, her hand moved toward the right without hesitation.

p_18765af7a5.sentence: Let me tell you an old tale of a semi-barbaric king who invented a strange way to judge his subjects.
p_18765af7a5.next: In his arena stood two identical doors.

p_3abf97bf2c.sentence: With gold and determination, she had discovered the secret of the doors.
p_3abf97bf2c.next: She also knew who waited behind one of them: one of the fairest young women at court.

p_d3f2311914.sentence: In his arena stood two identical doors.
p_d3f2311914.prev: Let me tell you an old tale of a semi-barbaric king who invented a strange way to judge his subjects.
p_d3f2311914.next: Behind one waited a hungry tiger; behind the other, a lovely lady.
